name: Coria del Río (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided yellow over white, the yellow charged with the emblem of Coria del Río (a ship above waves within a wreath).
history: Municipal flag of Coria del Río; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: ship within a wreath of leaves
waves beneath the ship and crossed anchors
